results.title: Election Commission Bars Both Mamata, Arup Roy Factions From Using TMC Name, ‘Flowers & Grass’ Symbol
results.description: The Election Commission has asked both factions to choose separate names and symbols for the ongoing by-elections. The dispute follows competing claims over the party’s National Working Committee and organisational control.
